additional_info.subject: ID0467596-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002554] CU logs' check CRM:03056000786
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support,
After carefully checking the logs, it seems that during the charging session there was a network error.
Because of this network error the communication between the car and the charger failed, and therefore there was no power being send to the car.
Right now the charger looks healthy and there are no live errors occurring.
In case you are still facing issues with the charger, please let us know.
In case the charger is working optimal, please provide us with this feedback, so we can close the ticket.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
eMobility Technical Support Team
